# RSAKeyValue

## Attributes


## Sub-elements

- **[Modulus](Modulus.md)**: The modulus of the RSA key.
- **[Exponent](Exponent.md)**: The exponent of the RSA key.

## Examples

```xml
<ds:RSAKeyValue xmlns:ds="http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#">
  <ds:Modulus></ds:Modulus>
  <ds:Exponent>AQAB</ds:Exponent>
</ds:RSAKeyValue>

```
